_comment: joinArm.String() over every member of the closed precedence enum, plus the out-of-range fallback. The ORDER of the members is the precedence itself (a smaller value is the stronger claim), so a row that renders the wrong name here means the coalescing tie-break is being reported against the wrong arm.

provenance.ref: joinArmAlias, the strongest arm: a curated alias named the catalog row outright
joinArmMechanical: the identity's own decomposition matched the catalog
joinArmInstructFallback: a bare size-only tag matched only after retrying with an instruct modifier
joinArmCommunity, the weakest arm: no catalog row, kept under the Ollama-native namespace ID
int value 99 is past the last member (community=3)

mutation.description: pushes the value past the end of the name table

provenance.ref: int value -1 is below the first member (alias=0)

mutation.description: pushes the value below the start of the name table
